note: Both sets capture the same core facts (47,402.91 N·m torque saturation, 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, 1173.7 rpm rated generator speed, single-DOF = shaft rotation, no torsional-vibration control loop) and each contains one unsupported figure read of 50,000 N·m: A places it at ~1,200 rpm and B binds it to the variable-speed curve at ~1,400 rpm, where that curve is well below 50,000 N·m. A uniquely records the high intrinsic structural damping of the drivetrain, while B uniquely records the PI control input (speed error between filtered and rated generator speed); each misses the other's fact. B additionally adds a trivial 0 N·m at 0 rpm claim, and both sets duplicate the saturation and control-goal claims, so A is marginally leaner and better.
